newsitem.title: FRANCE: AGF up on rumours, block trade.
newsitem.headline: AGF up on rumours, block trade.

text.p: Shares in French insurance group AGF were up by more than six percent before coming down again on continued rumours the company may be a takeover target, dealers said.
At 0938 GMT, AGF was up 1.88 percent at 222.00 francs after having hit a high of 231.40 francs.
Dealers said a block trade of 610,395 shares, or 0.4 percent of the total share capital, was made at 206 francs on Monday evening.
Standard & Poor's cut AGF's claims paying ability (CPA) for AGF to AA minus from AA.
AGF recently joined the CAC-40 index which created demand by investment funds that follow the blue-chip index.
But speculation is also a driving force and AGF has been sprinting upwards from 165.70 on January 24.

Germany's Allianz is often rumoured as a possible buyer of the company. A Salomon Brothers analyst was quoted as saying in the La Tribune newspaper on Tuesday that an acquisition by Allianz was "credible".
